messages:
maria: Quick async sync — final gating for model-catalog launch tomorrow. Need clarity on: ownership for three new open models (zephyr-lite, marlin-7b-lite, alcyon-sft), licensing signoffs, perf profile updates, and canary schedule. Tagging owners: @devon @sam @anita. TL;DR: Can we confirm owners + any blockers by EOD?

 devon: I've got zephyr-lite (model infra). License check passed earlier but waiting for legal artifact. Will own canary run.

 sam: I'll take marlin-7b-lite perf profiles. Running perf sweep today — expect numbers in ~3h. Any target SLOs we should aim for? (p50/p95 tokens/sec)

 maria: target p95 latency <= 200ms for 512 tokens; cost per 1k tokens target < $0.06 for hosted tier.

 anita: I'll own alcyon-sft licensing + manifest. Legal asked for dataset provenance note — I can get that by EOD if no new asks.

 devon: FYI infra will need quantized checkpoint for marlin to hit cost target. @sam can you confirm model format? we can accept q4_0.

 sam: marlin-7b-lite export supports q4_0 and q8_0. I'll push q4_0 export to the bucket in ~2h and update the manifest.

 lee: ops note — Dedicated capacity constraints in us-west from 09:30–12:00 PST tomorrow (maintenance). Recommend scheduling canary outside that window or route to eu for first pass.

 maria: good catch @lee. Proposed canary: start eu canary at 08:30 PST -> shift to us-west at 12:30 PST. Config snippet for rollout policy:

 maria: ```json
{
  "canary": [
    {"region":"eu-west-1","start":"2026-03-19T08:30:00-07:00","percent":10},
    {"region":"us-west-2","start":"2026-03-19T12:30:00-07:00","percent":25}
  ],
  "fallback":"model-v1"
}
```

 sam: fine with that. I'll tag the perf artifacts in the manifest and add a note about q4_0.

 anita: legal requires a short license summary string in manifest. Example: 'license: Apache-2.0; third-party weights: yes; provenance: see LICENSES/PROVENANCE.md' I'll attach by EOD.

 deploy-bot: Canary window scheduled in orchestration — pending owner approvals.

 maria: action items: devon (zephyr canary + infra readiness), sam (perf artifacts + q4_0 export), anita (license summary + manifest), lee (confirm routing policy for us-west->eu), i'll assemble release checklist and ping legal if needed. Please reply with 'ack' when done.

 devon: ack — will update infra runbook and confirm memory/perf matrices.

 sam: ack — perf artifacts ETA 2.5h.

 anita: ack — license blurb attached to PR 2384.

 lee: ack — routing policy set, will monitor.

 maria: thanks all. If anything blocks, DM me. :rocket:
